text.title: Outcome Based Roadmaps Procedure
text.summary: Six-step procedure for applying Outcome Based Roadmaps. Each step lists input, action, and output. Pause and surface the artefact when output is produced.

step.name: anchor-outcomes
step.action: Pick ≤3 outcomes per quarter aligned to OKRs.

step.name: attach-baselines
step.action: Pull the current metric value for each outcome from its dashboard; record the value and the dashboard URL on the outcome.

step.name: set-kill-signals
step.action: Set a falsifying kill threshold per outcome — metric floor plus the week by which it must clear.

step.name: propose-solutions
step.action: List 3-6 candidate solutions per outcome with confidence + month-range delivery window, and write the explicit not-doing list alongside them.

step.name: publish-and-review
step.action: Publish; at quarter-end run review and adjust.

decision-gate.p: After step 6, the artefact MUST satisfy the output contract in content/02-output-contract.xml before downstream consumers read it.
